The maintainer confirmed that the **PMX — Gene (Light)** model looks substantially better after Issue #61 / PR #62 changed its scene lights to the Three.js default intensity of **1**. However, the other examples still use brighter, explicitly specified lights in the shared [`examples/scene.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/examples/scene.ts):

```ts
const ambient = mode === 'gene' ? new AmbientLight( 0xffffff ) : new AmbientLight( 0xffffff, 2 );
scene.add( new PolarGridHelper( 30, 8 ), ambient );
const light = mode === 'gene' ? new DirectionalLight( 0xffffff ) : new DirectionalLight( 0xffffff, 3 );
```

The five cards in [`examples/index.html`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/examples/index.html) also use screenshots made for the previous scene appearance (the Miku Worker Physics card currently shares the Model and animation preview). They should reflect the updated lighting.

## Expected outcome

**All public Examples** — Model and animation, Audio and camera animation, Poses, Worker Physics, and PMX — Gene (Light) — use the **native Three.js defaults** for `AmbientLight` and `DirectionalLight` intensity (both 1 in the pinned Three.js). Prefer omitting intensity arguments to relying on explicit numeric `1`. Do not otherwise alter camera positions, model materials, animation, outlines, tone mapping or the lighting direction as part of this issue.

**Refresh the thumbnails for every Examples gallery card** based on the new lighting so the previews represent the actual current scenes, including the already-updated Gene Light PMX example. Capture preview frames from the real model/example scenes, not from generated test fixtures or unrelated substitutes. Existing Miku preview images are upstream Three.js-derived, and Gene's new preview is derived from CC BY 4.0 assets; update relevant origin/attribution/derivative-work notices when replacing them. Do not imply images or characters are licensed under the repository's MIT license.

### Pre-merge acceptance criteria

All required criteria must be verifiable before merge; a published GitHub Pages site and subjective maintainer sign-off are not merge requirements.

- [ ] Simplify `examples/scene.ts` so every mode instantiates the shared white `AmbientLight` and `DirectionalLight` with default intensities (1). Remove the PMX-only intensity conditional introduced in #61. Preserve existing color, direction/position and unrelated scene behavior.
- [ ] Update **every** gallery card's preview to match the current intensity-1 lighting: Model and animation, Audio and camera animation, Poses, Worker Physics, and PMX — Gene (Light). Update the underlying images and/or references in `examples/screenshots/` and `examples/index.html` as needed. A separate Worker thumbnail is welcome if it improves accuracy; do not leave any card showing an outdated brighter rendering.
- [ ] Capture thumbnails using the real legally permitted models/assets and representative scene state for each example. Preserve the current thumbnail format/dimensions or adapt the gallery safely. Document any reproducible capture method and source/provenance. Do not replace thumbnails with fixture models or unlicensed images.
- [ ] Preserve/adjust `examples/README.md`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and any other affected attribution/asset notices as necessary, including the separate Gene Light CC BY 4.0 and Miku/Three.js asset rights. Keep screenshots and other example assets out of the npm package if that is the current policy.
- [ ] Add or update automated checks showing default light intensities for **all modes**, that all five gallery cards reference valid refreshed thumbnails, and that example navigation/loading still works.
- [ ] Run and report pre-merge `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`, `npm run build`, `npm run build:examples`, relevant built-artifact/thumbnail checks and `git diff --check`. Use the existing repository's expected fixture/real-asset paths as appropriate.
- [ ] Keep the scope to scene light intensity and thumbnail/notice updates, **not** an MMD shading or color-space algorithm change. Do not claim exact MikuMikuDance parity or a separately confirmed visual outcome merely because tests pass.

### Required post-merge verification

**After merging**, confirm the merge-triggered GitHub Pages workflow completes successfully and publishes the merged commit. Check that the public [Examples gallery](https://takahirox.github.io/three-mmd-loader/examples/) serves the updated thumbnails for all five cards and that the corresponding pages load without asset or runtime errors. Record the workflow URL, deployed commit/date and results. Report these as **PENDING** until they have actually been performed; if publication fails, file a follow-up rather than misreporting success.

**Post-merge Pages checks and any optional subjective visual review must NOT block pre-merge PR approval or merging.**

## Context

- #61 / [PR #62](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/62): PMX Gene Light intensity adjustment, which the maintainer reports improves the model appearance. This issue generalizes that choice to all examples and refreshes previews.
- [Current example scene](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/examples/scene.ts) and [gallery](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/examples/index.html).
- [Three.js r186 Light defaults](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r186/src/lights/Light.js): `intensity = 1`.
- [Examples README](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/examples/README.md) documents the origin and rights of both original Miku gallery previews and the Gene Light preview.
